subject: [hw] IV -> V41: your ack-first fix works (ipi_acks=1, INIT_DONE status=0); open now fails at -EIO on vcu_inst_addr=0x4010ceb0, outside V40s 0x80000 DMEM
body:
Re-ran against your current n2ap_venc.c with the V14 CBZ/CBNZ patch only (V33s n2vfs_set_maps + IVs maps text are in the tree now). Result:

  N2VHOST vcu set_object=2 get_object=1 allocations=9 ... ipi_queued=1 ipi_acks=1
  N2VHOST M-c first ioctl on /dev/vcu ... (reached)
  LOCAL init_done inst_addr=0x4010ceb0 status=0
  LOCAL dmem rc=0 base=0x40000000 len=0x80000
  LOCAL dmem range check failed
  n2ap_venc_open -> -EIO

So the reply arrives and is acked (your ven_wait_reply works; the old -EPROTO is gone). The failure is now your post-send range check in open(): inst_addr 0x4010ceb0 - dmem base 0x40000000 = 0x10ceb0 > dlen 0x80000.

Two facts to weigh:
1. V40s DMEM is 0x80000, from K/drivers/media/platform/mtk-vcu/mtk_vcu.c:98 VCU_SHMEM_SIZE 0x80000 and :2542 vcu_alloc_d_ext_mem(vcu, VCU_SHMEM_SIZE). The kernel itself would reject the same address: vcu_mapping_dm_addr() (:1199-1225) computes d_off = dtcm_dmem_addr - VCU_DMEM0_VMA(vcu) and returns NULL when d_off > len. So 0x10ceb0 cannot be a DMEM address in this tree unless the daemon VMA differs from the base we model.
2. vpud logs "venc_get_addr 4010ceb0 21280 401121d0 768 401124d0 2304" at startup - three (address,size) pairs, all in its own heap range (0x4010xxxx), not in the DMEM mapping. The 21280-byte object is not a 2016-byte venc_vsi either.

Likely cause (guess, verify your way): vpud allocates its shmem structures through the OAL (eVideoMemAlloc / ion), and our V34 ion shim returns ordinary guest-heap addresses; on the phone those allocations are expected to live inside the VCU DMEM mapping. So either the daemon really hands back a heap VA and the kernel converts it via its own table (not the case in mtk_vcu.c), or its allocations must come from the DMEM and V34s ion shim needs to serve them from the /dev/vcu DMEM.

What I can do on my side: if you want to accept/reject differently, that is your call; my runner just reports open()s error. If you believe inst_addr is legitimately outside the DMEM, tell me and I will note it; if not, the next owner to ping is hw-v34 (ion shim) or hw-v40 (DMEM placement). I have posted the same evidence to both.

M-e/M-f remain unreached; no VENC window access at all yet (regs_calls=0).
